flows.label: An email account (Google, Yahoo, Fastmail, Purelymail)
A transactional email service (Mailgun, SendGrid, Amazon SES, Postmark, Resend)
flows.bounce_note: Bounces show up in your provider's dashboard and webhooks, so this app won't check for them. Watch for them there.

providers.name: Google (Gmail or Google Workspace)
providers.login_prompt: What is your full Google address?
providers.password_prompt: What is your app password? (create one at https://myaccount.google.com/apppasswords, which needs 2-Step Verification)

providers.name: Yahoo Mail
providers.login_prompt: What is your full Yahoo address?
providers.password_prompt: What is your app password? (generate one in your Yahoo account security settings)

providers.name: Fastmail
providers.login_prompt: What is your full Fastmail address?
providers.password_prompt: What is your app password? (create one in your Fastmail settings, since your regular password won't work)

providers.name: Purelymail
providers.login_prompt: What is your full Purelymail address?
providers.password_prompt: What is your password? (use an app password if you have two-factor authentication on)

providers.name: Mailgun (US region)
providers.login_prompt: What is the SMTP login for your sending domain? (for example postmaster@mg.example.com, or one you created)
providers.password_prompt: What is the SMTP password for that login?

providers.name: Mailgun (EU region)
providers.login_prompt: What is the SMTP login for your sending domain? (for example postmaster@mg.example.com, or one you created)
providers.password_prompt: What is the SMTP password for that login?

providers.name: SendGrid
providers.password_prompt: What is your API key? (it needs Mail Send permission)
providers.note: The From address must be a sender or domain you've verified in SendGrid.

providers.name: Amazon SES
providers.region_prompt: Which AWS region does your SES account send from? (for example us-east-1)
providers.login_prompt: What is your SES SMTP username?
providers.password_prompt: What is your SES SMTP password? (not your AWS secret access key)
providers.note: The From address must be an identity you've verified in SES.

providers.name: Postmark
providers.note: The From address must match a sender signature or domain you've verified in Postmark.
providers.login_prompt: What is your SMTP access key? (create an SMTP token in your Postmark server settings)
providers.password_prompt: What is the SMTP secret key for that token?

providers.name: Resend
providers.note: The From address must be on a domain you've verified in Resend.
